comments.regular: Verified AStarNodeList vtable from RTTI. Oblivion's queue uses a linked list: Add appends each node, and PopLowestTotalEstimateCost scans all entries for minimum F. Fallout's AStarQueue<NavMeshSearchNode,NavMeshSearchLink> is a distinct 84-byte structure with fMaxFitness plus 20 bucket heads; AddNode bins normalized F into one of 20 buckets and sorts within the bucket, while PopFront takes the first nonempty bucket. This is a verified queue-implementation divergence; no layout is transferred.

confidence_scope: Raw live IDA annotation; bulk synchronization does not independently verify semantic names or comments.
